questions.stem: Which of the following is a function of middlemen in produce trade?

options.text: They increase the distance between producers and consumers.
They facilitate transactions between buyers and sellers.

questions.explanation: Middlemen facilitate transactions, making option c the correct answer. Options a and d misrepresent their role, while option b is the opposite of what they do.

distractorRationale.a: Option a is incorrect because middlemen do not produce goods.
distractorRationale.b: Option b is incorrect as middlemen actually reduce the distance between producers and consumers.
distractorRationale.c: Option d is incorrect because middlemen do not set prices; they help in the transaction.

questions.stem: What is one aim of a commodity exchange?
questions.explanation: One of the main aims of a commodity exchange is to stabilize prices by providing a marketplace for trading commodities. Options a, c, and d do not reflect the true aims of a commodity exchange.

distractorRationale.a: Option a is incorrect because exchanges promote competition, not eliminate it.
distractorRationale.b: Option c is incorrect as exchanges aim to increase access to goods.
distractorRationale.c: Option d is incorrect because exchanges are legal and regulated.
